benchmark_metrics.definition: Number of proofread neurons in the whole-brain connectome
benchmark_metrics.notes: Matches our local canonical connection count exactly.

benchmark_metrics.definition: Filtered subset of neurons included in functional simulation
benchmark_metrics.notes: Our dataset retains the full 139,255 graph. This model-specific value represents a thresholded subgraph.

benchmark_metrics.definition: Total chemical synapses across proofread neurons
benchmark_metrics.notes: External count is ~54.5M. Our total_synapse_count is 50,666,648. Difference is typical of connectome processing rules.

benchmark_metrics.definition: Synaptic edges preserved in the dynamical simulation
benchmark_metrics.notes: Their reported ~50M is very close to our 50,666,648 tally.

benchmark_metrics.source: Schlegel et al. 2024 Nature / FlyWire Codex
benchmark_metrics.definition: Unique distinct cell type annotations assigned to proofread neurons
benchmark_metrics.notes: Our pipeline pulls from consolidated_cell_types.csv.gz. Strict match depends on the timestamp/version of annotations mirrored locally.
